instruction: Candid action photograph, full shot, eye-level. Inside a karate dojo with yellow walls, red and blue floor mats, and wall-mounted swords, two martial artists practice a drill. On the left, the man in the black t-shirt with white-striped pants (R1) lunges forward to the right, extending his right arm in a strike. On the right, the woman in the black t-shirt with a red belt (R2) faces left, raising her left forearm to block his incoming arm. Bright overhead lighting illuminates the warm-toned room and colorful mats.
elements: R1 lunges forward and extends his right arm in a strike toward R2
R2 raises her left forearm to block R1's incoming arm
R1 is the striker while R2 is the blocker in the drill
R2 faces R1 while blocking the strike with her forearm
red and blue floor mats in the karate dojo

questions.q: Is R1 the martial artist lunging forward and extending his right arm in a strike toward R2, rather than R2 striking toward R1?
questions.element: R1 lunges forward and extends his right arm in a strike toward R2

questions.element: R2 raises her left forearm to block R1's incoming arm

questions.q: Is R1 playing the attacking striker role while R2 plays the defensive blocker role in the drill?
questions.element: R1 is the striker while R2 is the blocker in the drill

questions.element: R2 faces R1 while blocking the strike with her forearm
